reads_as: Every Fab Lab in the fablabs.io directory that gives a place, as directory facts: name, city, country, coordinates, kind and the activity status the lab states. A status is the lab's own claim, not a check.
licence: Directory facts from fablabs.io, shown on the Fab City Index map by decision of Tomas Diez, co-owner of fablabs.io (2026-10-14). fablabs.io's Terms of Use apply and are not an open licence: each lab keeps the copyright in what it wrote, which is why only names, places, kinds and statuses are shown, each linking to the lab's own page.
source: Fab Lab network data archive, gitlab.fabcloud.org/fl-management/fablab-network-data, archive/labs.json/20260930_1907_labs.json
